articulation.label: cap
articulation.alt: cap: /k/ → /æ/ → /p/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /k/: Back of tongue meets the soft palate; release.
/æ/: Low front tongue; open the jaw.
/p/: Close the lips, then release the air.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: cat
articulation.alt: cat: /k/ → /æ/ → /t/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /k/: Back of tongue meets the soft palate; release.
/æ/: Low front tongue; open the jaw.
/t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: back
articulation.alt: back: /b/ → /æ/ → /k/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /b/: Close lips briefly; release into the next vowel.
/æ/: Low front tongue; open the jaw.
/k/: Back of tongue meets the soft palate; release.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: bag
articulation.alt: bag: /b/ → /æ/ → /ɡ/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /b/: Close lips briefly; release into the next vowel.
/æ/: Low front tongue; open the jaw.
/ɡ/: Back of tongue meets the soft palate; add voice.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

cards.title: Five words to hear and use
sections: to a place where someone was before. Puck comes back at six.
Having the darkest color. The cat is black.
The part of the body between the head and shoulders. The scarf is around my neck.
A hard piece of stone. A small rock is beside the path.
something that shows the time. A clock is on the wall.
